descriptionChirho: Physically unblemished, without defect — used of sacrificial animals and offerings required to be free from any bodily imperfection (Lev, Num, Ezek).

Morally blameless, having integrity — used of persons who walk uprightly before God, including substantival uses ('the blameless ones') and adverbial/prepositional expressions ('in integrity, blamelessly').
Perfect, flawless — predicated of God's way, work, or law, denoting absolute completeness and faultlessness in the divine standard.
Complete, whole, entire — used of things such as full time-periods, whole stones, or a complete lot (Urim/Thummim), indicating nothing is lacking or deficient.
